method: An independent reference computes the correctly-rounded binary64 result with exact integer arithmetic only -- arbitrary-precision mantissa, rounding decided by integer comparison, no floating point in the decision path. It shares no code with the implementation under test.

interpretation.oracle_vs_zig: Correctness under IEEE-754 round-to-nearest-ties-to-even. A disagreement is a defect in this port.
interpretation.oracle_vs_libc: Whether the platform libc is itself correctly rounded. A disagreement is a statement about libc, not about the port.
